content.text: spasticity: escalating doses of baclofen or tizanidine; botulinum toxin inj if PO tx fails

Titrate: 5 mg t.i.d. 3 days · 10 mg t.i.d. 3 days · 15 mg t.i.d. 3 days · 20 mg t.i.d. 3 days. Start ↓ & ↑ gradually until optimum effect (USU 40 to 80 mg daily). Max TDD 80 mg (20 mg q.i.d.). Lowest dose compatible w optimal response recommended - slowly w.draw if ⍉benefit after a reasonable trial

CI: hypersensitivity to baclofen. Hallucinations & sz occurred on abrupt w.draw — reduce dose slowly when discontinuing. Primarily excreted unchanged by kidneys — give w caution - may be necessary to reduce the dosage. Neonatal w.draw (↑ musc tone · tremor · jitteriness · sz) reported hrs to days after delivery in neonates of mothers treated throughout preg

Sedation poss — caution w driving/machinery - CNS effects may be additive to alcohol & other CNS depressants. Epilepsy: monitor clin state & EEG @ regular intervals (deterioration in sz control/EEG reported occasionally)

OD signs: vomiting · musc hypotonia · drowsiness · accommodation dx · coma · resp depression · sz. OD tx: empty stomach (emesis then lavage) if alert - if obtunded secure airway w cuffed endotracheal tube b4 lavage (do ⍉induce emesis) - maintain resp exchg - do ⍉use resp stimulants

Start 2 mg PO every 6 to 8 h prn, max three doses in 24 h. ↑ by 2 mg to 4 mg per dose every 1 to 4 days - max TDD 36 mg. Renal impairment (CrCl <25 mL/min) or hepatic impairment: use lower individual doses during titration - ↑ individual doses rather than freq. Monitor aminotransferase levels @ baseline & 1 mo after max dose = achieved
strong CYP1A2 inhibitors. CI: Hx of hypersensitivity to tizanidine or ingredients (anaphylaxis · angioedema)

↓BP risk minimized by dose titration - monitor ↓BP signs/Sx b4 dose increase. Monitor ↓BP w concurrent antiHTN therapy. May cause liver inj - monitor ALTs - d/c if liver inj. CNS depressant effects w alcohol & other CNS depressants (ex, benzodiazepines, opioids, tricyclic antidepressants) may be additive. May cause hallucinations - consider d/c Zanaflex. W.draw (rebound HTN, tachy, hypertonia): ↓dose slowly, esp after ↑doses (20 to 28 mg daily) for long periods (9 wks or more) or w narcotics.

Strong CYP1A2 inhibitors (fluvoxamine, cipro) ↑tizanidine exposure - significantly ↓BP · ↑drowsiness · ↑psychomotor impairment. OD: ↓sensorium (lethargy · somnolence · confusion · coma) - depressed ♡ funct (most often brady · hypotension) - resp depression.
